description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio and two metrics: Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis represents the Recent Sequence Ratio, ranging from 0 to 100% with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20%. The left y-axis represents Perplexity, spanning from 4.2 to 4.7 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1, while the right y-axis represents the GPU Memory Ratio, ranging from 40 to 100% with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10%. The plot displays four lines: Perplexity (orange, solid line with circle markers), Full Cache PPL (red, dashed line), GPU Memory Ratio (blue, solid line with circle markers), and Full Cache GPU Mem. (red, dashed line). The Perplexity line starts at approximately 4.65 at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 10%, decreases to around 4.3 at 40%, remains relatively stable until 80%, and then increases to about 4.35 at 100%. The GPU Memory Ratio line begins at around 42% at a Recent Sequence Ratio of 10%, gradually increases to approximately 55% at 80%, and then sharply rises to nearly 100% at 100%. The Full Cache PPL and Full Cache GPU Mem. lines remain constant at approximately 4.4 and 60%, respectively, across the entire range of Recent Sequence Ratios.
